Prompt.title: Prompt
Prompt.description: User prompt entity synchronized across devices

preview.description: Collapsed short preview of the prompt content

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the prompt was created

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the prompt title, content, or tags were last modified

lastUsed.description: ISO timestamp when the prompt was last copied or used

useCount.description: Number of times the prompt has been used or copied

Tombstone.title: Tombstone
Tombstone.description: Deletion tombstone preventing resurrecting deleted prompts across devices

deletedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the prompt was deleted

/users/{userId}/prompts/{promptId}.description: Collection of prompts belonging to a specific authenticated user

/users/{userId}/tombstones/{promptId}.description: Collection of deletion tombstones belonging to a specific authenticated user
